title: Walking Robot Simulation
description: Simulate robot movement on an infinite plane with commands and obstacles to find the max squared Euclidean distance.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize pos=(0,0), dir=0 (N), maxDist=0
2. For each command in commands:
3. If command is -1: dir = (dir + 1) % 4
4. If command is -2: dir = (dir + 3) % 4
5. Else: Move step by step until hit obstacle or k steps

steps.note: Execute command 4: Move North 4 units to (0,4).
Execute command -1: Turn right, new direction East (dir=1).
Execute command 3: Move East 3 units to (3,4).
